newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates close lower at 20.75 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates close lower at 20.75 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates fell on Thursday amid higher market liquidity before the end of the banks' reserve period, dealers said.
Rates opened at 21.5 percent and slid to 20.75 percent by the close, compared with Wednesday's end of 21 percent.
"Banks have replenished their supplies ahead of the end of the reserve period so there's plenty of liquidity," said Erika Kaiser of Budapest Bank.
The overnight rates were seen keeping their present relatively low level until the end of the reserve period on Friday. -- Budapest newsroom (36 1) 327 4040
